accepted_game.source: La Grande Evening Observer, 1939-02-08 p.7 (original United Press); The News and the Herald, 1939-02-08 p.8 (college scoreboard)
accepted_game.notes: Original Feb.8 UP item: Gonzaga defeated touring University of Mexico basketball team 58-40 'last night' (Feb.7). Feb.8 News and Herald independent college-scoreboard publication repeats 58-40. Feb.3 La Grande Observer calls touring National University of Mexico squad university varsity; Montana official 1938-39 varsity game ledger records same opponent Feb.8 and counts result in 17-13 season, corroborating varsity competitive status but not itself Gonzaga classification. Not described as exhibition in preserved game reports. Spokane UP dateline is NOT proof of physical venue or HOME, so site_type UNKNOWN. Distinct Gonzaga Feb.7 date/opponent/score not found in 557-row ledger. Earlier source lead GONZAGA-LEAD-193839-MEXICO-001 accepted under Research identity; do not assign global key until Stage 2.
